role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 兽王在战场上行走从来都是准备万全。他可以召唤喷毒的野猪和刺探敌情的战鹰协助狩猎，挥舞双斧劈开丛林中的树木，他震耳欲聋的咆哮将为盟友开出一条灭敌之路。
hero_summary_en: Summoning a poison-spitting boar and a scouting hawk to aid his hunt, Beastmaster never stalks the battlefield unprepared. Chopping through the forest with his axes, his stunning roar opens the way for his allies to devastate enemies.

abilities.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
abilities.description_zh: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.

shard_loc.en: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
shard_loc.zh: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

abilities.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
abilities.description_zh: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

abilities.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
abilities.description_zh: 兽王召唤%hawk_count%只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以%hawk_base_attack_interval%秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并缠绕。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.

shard_loc.en: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.
shard_loc.zh: 战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

abilities.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
abilities.description_zh: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。
notes_en: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
facet_text_en: Attack Speed bonus is increased by the number of units affected by Inner Beast.
Can be activated to increase Beastmaster's attack speed and allow him to apply the Wild Axes damage amplification debuff on his attack target.
facet_text_zh: 攻击速度加成根据野性之心作用下的单位数量还会有所增加。
可以主动开启，提升兽王的攻击速度，并且他会对他的攻击目标施加野性之斧的伤害加深负面效果。

abilities.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
abilities.description_zh: 兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，%max_stacks%次攻击后降低至最短%min_drum_hit_interval%秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。使用原始咆哮时自动增加%primal_roar_stacks%层敲鼓叠加效果。
abilities.description_en: Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.

abilities.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
abilities.description_zh: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并眩晕，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得%movement_speed%%%移动速度提升，持续%movement_speed_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_9
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_amp}% Wild Axes Damage Amp Per Stack

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_5
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_ms} Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons
talents_raw.desc_loc: The Movespeed Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_2
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_boar_bonus_damage} Damage to Beastmaster and his summons

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_6
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_hp} Health to Beastmaster and his summons
talents_raw.desc_loc: The Max Health Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_wild_axe_cooldown
talents_raw.desc_loc: Axes still must return to Beastmaster before they can be cast again.
